title: Pullback of a compatible étale system to an arbitrary cone
statement: Let $I$ be a preordered set and $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Sch}$ a diagram of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Let $F_i$ be abelian sheaves on the small étale site of $D_i$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. For $f:i\to j$ write $u_f=D(f^{\mathrm{op}}):D_j\to D_i$, and suppose given $\varphi_f:u_f^{-1}F_i\to F_j$, where inverse image is as in [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Assume $\varphi_{\mathrm{id}}$ is the canonical inverse-image identity comparison, including transport along $D(\mathrm{id})=\mathrm{id}$. Assume $\varphi_{g\circ f}=\varphi_g\circ u_g^{-1}(\varphi_f)\circ c_{u_g,u_f}$, with transport along $D(g\circ f)=u_f\circ u_g$, where $c$ identifies inverse image along a composite with iterated inverse image. Let $c$ be any cone over $D$ with point $X$ and legs $c_i:X\to D_i$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. There exist a functor $G:I\to\operatorname{Ab}(X_{\acute et})$ and isomorphisms $e_i:G_i\simeq c_i^{-1}F_i$ such that $G(f)=e_j^{-1}\circ c_j^{-1}(\varphi_f)\circ c_{c_j,u_f}\circ e_i$, where the cone equation identifies $c_i$ with $c_j$ followed by $u_f$. No limit, injectivity or exactness hypothesis is required.

source.place: Product/direct-image system construction in the proof of Tag 0EXZ, with exact inverse image and stage cokernels from Tag 04JC; the pullback of a compatible étale system to an arbitrary cone portion of the parent stage-diagram proof.

proof.text: Set G_i=c_i inverse image of F_i, with identity e_i. Define the arrow at f as upperStarComp for c_j and u_f followed by c_j inverse image of phi_f. Substitute the coefficient identity law and D.map_id; the right unit law for upperStarComp cancels the unit comparisons, giving map_id.

For f followed by g, substitute coefficient composition. Naturality moves the inverse image of phi_f past the cone comparison for g. Associativity of upperStarComp identifies the nested comparisons, using the cone equations and D.map_comp. This proves map_comp. Identity e_i give the displayed transition equation.

theorem etale_system_cone_functor
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D)
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hidentity : ∀ i : I, φ (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (F i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj (op i))).hom.app (F i))
    (hcomposition : ∀ (i j k : I) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k),
      φ (f ≫ g) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op) (D.map f.op)
          (D.map (f ≫ g).op) (D.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op)).map (φ f) ≫ φ g)
 :
    ∃ (G : I ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eG : ∀ i : I, G.obj i ≅
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).obj (F i)),
    ∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), G.map f =
      (eG i).hom ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j)) (D.map f.op)
          (c.π.app (op i)) (c.w f.op).symm).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j))).map (φ f) ≫ (eG j).inv
